The left-rail Smart Degen mini feed was not used as the tape (it was used only to resolve full wallet addresses when a visible /sol/address/<FULL> href matched a board label by first 4 and last 4 characters). The board is a set of per-token cards, each listing up to 3 wallet rows, and it reorders every few seconds. Pass-1 cards that later scrolled out of the DOM kept their first-read rows. The board held a limited set of cards, which limited further unique rows.
